name: Multi Layered Wooden Plaque with LED
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material: Made from 3 layers of high-quality 5mm thick wood with precision laser cut, ensuring durability and a smooth finish.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

- Available in 3 size options: 8 x 8 inches ~20.3 x20.3 cm; 10 x 10 inches ~25.4 x25.4 cm; 12 x 12 inches ~ 30.5 x 30.5 cm .

- Original dimension before the shape is customized, please allow up to 1’ difference in height or width.

-  Total thickness 1.5cm ~0.59in.

 

  • LED Light Features:

-   LED's life span - 30.000 hours.Voltage: 5V, 0.5A

- USB-Powered Convenience: Comes with an easy-to-use USB power supply, making it energy-efficient and easy to set up anywhere—no batteries needed! It works with desktop computers, laptops, and power banks with USB input. NOTE: Wall charger is NOT included.

- Warm & Cozy Glow – The LED lights create a stunning effect, enhancing the engraved details and adding warmth to any room. Perfect for bedrooms, living rooms, or even workspaces.

  • Colors change:

- Multi-color: Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Cyan, Pink and White

- Monochrome: Yellow

- Touch Mode: Please press the touch button once to change one color, if press 7th times, the colors will be changed automatically. Hold switch down for 2 seconds to turn off.

 

  • Versatile Home Decor: Ideal for bedrooms, living rooms, offices, or kids' rooms. It serves as a beautiful decorative piece during the day and an enchanting light source at night.

 

  • Perfect Gift Choice: A meaningful and thoughtful present for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, or housewarming celebrations. It adds a personalized touch that makes any occasion special.
  • Packaging: 1 x Wooden Plaque with LED + 1 x Wooden Display Stand.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
